title: ReturnFlow simulated return policy: apparel resale conditions

clauses.content: An order must have delivered status and a recorded delivery date before a return can be approved.
A return request must be made within 30 days after the recorded delivery date. Day 30 is inside the return window; after day 30 is outside it.
An item marked final sale cannot be returned under the simulated policy.
An item with an existing return request must not create a second return request.
The return reason is required. Wearing clothing is a condition fact, not by itself a return reason.
The requester must identify the order using the matching customer email. Email matching is not production authentication.
Defective or wrong-item claims, conflicting facts, and explicit requests for a person go to human review rather than automatic approval. Non-apparel damage also goes to human review.
For non-apparel only, a non-defective return must be unused; unknown use status requires clarification. This unused-only restriction does not apply to apparel.

For catalog-classified clothing, wearing alone does not disqualify a return. Resale condition requires no stains, no item damage, original tags attached, and tags intact. These facts must be explicitly stated or answered; unused does not prove them. All delivery, deadline, final-sale and duplicate checks still apply. This is customer-reported pre-screening, not physical inspection.

Customer-caused stains, item damage, removed tags or damaged tags make clothing ineligible under the simulated resale-condition policy. Wearing without these adverse conditions is not a rejection reason.

If clothing has an adverse condition, ask whether the customer caused it or it was already present on delivery. Pre-existing adverse conditions or explicitly unknown cause require human review; missing cause requires clarification, never guessed blame.

An eligible item creates only a simulated return request after explicit customer confirmation. Apparel requires all four resale-condition checks; non-apparel retains its unused-item condition. No real refund or shipping label is issued.
